messages.text: Quick one: does anyone have a go-to estate planning attorney we've referred to before? One of Janet's clients, {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0276}}, is asking after a recent life change and wants trust/will work done.
We've used the same two outside firms for years. Check the referral list in ClientHub under Vendors > Legal. Last I looked the trusts & estates firm was still accepting new wealth clients.
I can pull the list and send it over. Michael, do you want both firms or just the T&E one?
Both please, Sandra. Client likes options. Also should I loop Janet in since she's the RM? I'm just covering the portfolio side on this one.

Reminder on estate referrals: we introduce, we don't recommend. Give two or three names, document it in ClientHub, and no fee arrangements with the firms. Compliance was firm on this at the last review.
Yes, and log the note as a referral, not advice. I had a note bounced last quarter because I wrote 'recommended' instead of 'introduced'.
Definitely loop Janet. Her notes show the client prefers email over calls. Contact is {{CLIENT_EMAIL:c_0276}} per ClientHub if you need it.
Thanks James. I'll ping Janet now and send the list through her so the relationship stays with her.
Related: Jamie's client {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0247}} asked something similar last month. Does anyone know if we ever got feedback from the T&E firm on turnaround? Want to set expectations.
Last two I referred heard back within a week and had an initial consult in about two. Full documents took 6-8 weeks, depending on how complex the trust structure was.
Sent you both firm contacts in a DM, Michael. I also attached the one-page referral disclosure template so it goes out with the intro.
Got it, thank you. Janet confirmed she'll send the intro today and I'll add the portfolio context in PortfolioMgr once beneficiary info is updated.
Once the attorney is engaged, we'll probably need to retitle some holdings. Please flag that early to ops. Brokerage {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00567}} will be the one affected for Michael's client.
I can prep the retitling checklist so it's ready when the trust docs arrive. Should I include the cash management account {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00568}} too?
Yes, include both. Better to have the full picture before the attorney asks for it.
That's helpful, Kelly. I'll tell Jamie to set client expectations at 6-8 weeks, and I'll add a follow-up task for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0247}} in ClientHub for next week.
